title: TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
abstract: arXiv:2611.34762v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on external memory, yet they still hallucinate about what they remember. Often the correct memory is retrieved and placed in the prompt, but the answer contradicts it or the memory is applied to the wrong question. We call these use-time memory hallucinations. Across five open models, we find that they arise from the conflict between parametric knowledge and external memory and take three forms: memory-ignoring, where the model returns to a stale fact in its weights (up to 46% of queries); memory-misapplying, where it attributes the memory to unrelated entities (up to 24%, and 49% when retrieval is combined with weight editing); and version confusion, where 53% of answers about revised facts assert the superseded value when both versions remain stored. We propose TASK memory, which goes beyond text-only memory by combining a Text note with Activation Steering and Knowledge editing that share one in-model addr

translated_title: TASK记忆：通过激活引导与知识编辑超越纯文本记忆，对抗记忆幻觉
translated_abstract: LLM智能体越来越依赖外部记忆，但它们仍会对所记忆的内容产生幻觉。通常正确的记忆已被检索并放入提示中，但模型的回答却与之矛盾，或将记忆应用到错误的问题上。我们将这类现象称为“使用时记忆幻觉”。在五个开源模型上的研究发现，这些幻觉源于参数知识与外部记忆之间的冲突，并呈现三种形式：记忆忽视，即模型回退到权重中过时的旧事实（最高占46%的查询）；记忆误用，即模型将记忆错误地归因于无关实体（最高占24%，当检索与权重编辑结合使用时高达49%）；版本混淆，即当新旧两个版本的记忆同时存储时，53%关于已修订事实的回答仍断言被取代的旧值。为此，我们提出TASK记忆，通过将文本笔记与激活引导和知识编辑相结合，超越纯文本记忆，三者共享一个模型内的统一寻址空间……（摘要原文此处截断）
tldr: 提出TASK记忆方法，将文本笔记、激活引导与知识编辑融合于统一的模型内寻址空间，有效对抗LLM智能体因参数知识与外部记忆冲突而产生的记忆忽视、记忆误用和版本混淆三种使用时记忆幻觉。
en_tdlr: TASK Memory combines a text note with activation steering and knowledge editing in one shared in-model addressing space to combat three forms of use-time memory hallucination (memory-ignoring, memory-misapplying, and version confusion) that arise from conflicts between parametric knowledge and external memory in LLM agents.
